verdict.rationale: Devin has scattered permission-related concepts—MCP tools 'subject to the same permission system as built-in tools' with control 'at multiple levels', interactive handoff/takeover between web and IDE, and interactive browser intervention—suggesting some human-in-the-loop control points, but there is no documented feature for an engineering-lead to configure tiered autonomy levels (e.g., auto-approve vs require-confirmation policies) across the org or per-agent.
